# ProtocolAccessManagerV2
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/access-contracts/src/contracts/ProtocolAccessManagerV2.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IProtocolAccessManagerV2](../interfaces/i-protocol-access-manager-v2.md), [ProtocolAccessManager](./protocol-access-manager.md)

**Title:**
ProtocolAccessManagerV2

Extends `ProtocolAccessManager` with a per-contract `OPERATOR_ROLE`, a global
`WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE`, and a per-context whitelist used to gate user interaction
with institutional Fleet variants.

Role hierarchy:
- Governor bootstraps every other role (including the Whitelist Manager) and is the only
role that can grant or revoke contract-specific Operator roles.
- Whitelist Manager owns mutations on the per-context whitelist (`setWhitelisted`,
`setWhitelistedBatch`, `setWhitelistOpen`).
- Operator (per contract, scoped via `generateRole(OPERATOR_ROLE, contract)`) is consulted
by inheriting contracts (`ProtocolAccessManagedV2.hasOperatorRole`) and lets bundlers
(e.g. AdmiralsQuartersWhitelist, RoundsVaultInput/Output) bypass a Fleet's user-side
gateway when invoking it.

Whitelist semantics: `isWhitelisted(context, account)` returns `true` when either the
context's whitelist has been globally opened (`setWhitelistOpen(context, true)`) or when
the explicit `(context, account)` mapping is set. The context is typically the Fleet
address performing the check — granting one whitelist record unblocks every entry path
that uses that Fleet as its context.

Replaces `ProtocolAccessManager` for institutional Fleet variants; legacy components keep
using the V1 manager.


## State Variables
### MAX_WHITELIST_BATCH_SIZE
Hard cap on the number of accounts a single `setWhitelistedBatch` call may touch.
Prevents unbounded loops and keeps per-call gas predictable.


```solidity
uint256 public constant MAX_WHITELIST_BATCH_SIZE = 200
```


### WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE
Role identifier for the global Whitelist Manager who may mutate the per-context
whitelist (`setWhitelisted`, `setWhitelistedBatch`, `setWhitelistOpen`).


```solidity
bytes32 public constant WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE = keccak256("WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE")
```


### _whitelisted
Per-context, per-account whitelist record. Reads go through `isWhitelisted` /
`areWhitelisted`, which also consider the context's global-open flag.


```solidity
mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _whitelisted
```


### _isWhitelistOpen
Per-context flag that, when `true`, makes every account read as whitelisted for
that context regardless of the explicit `_whitelisted` record.


```solidity
mapping(address => bool) private _isWhitelistOpen
```


## Functions
### constructor

Initializes the access manager with `governor` as the initial Governor and seeds it
with the `WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE` so the deployment can immediately manage whitelist
state before any other Whitelist Manager is granted.


```solidity
constructor(address governor) ProtocolAccessManager(governor);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`governor`|`address`|Initial Governor address (typically the protocol multisig).|


### supportsInterface

Checks if the contract supports a given interface

Overrides the supportsInterface function from AccessControl


```solidity
function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`interfaceId`|`bytes4`|The interface identifier, as specified in ERC-165|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool True if the contract supports the interface, false otherwise This function supports: - IProtocolAccessManager interface - All interfaces supported by the parent AccessControl contract|


### grantOperatorRole

Grants the contract-specific Operator role for `fleetCommanderAddress` to `account`.

Despite the parameter name, the Operator role is scoped to any contract that exposes
`hasOperatorRole(account)` against itself — typically a Fleet, but also AdmiralsQuarters
and the rounds vaults. Inheriting contracts (via `ProtocolAccessManagedV2`) use the role
to let trusted bundler/proxy contracts bypass user-side gateways. Restricted to the
Governor role.


```solidity
function grantOperatorRole(address fleetCommanderAddress, address account) public onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fleetCommanderAddress`|`address`|The contract the Operator role is scoped to (typically a Fleet)|
|`account`|`address`|The account to grant the role to|


### revokeOperatorRole

Revokes the contract-specific Operator role for `fleetCommanderAddress` from `account`.

Despite the parameter name, the Operator role is contract-scoped — it applies to any
contract that exposes `hasOperatorRole(account)` against itself (see
`ProtocolAccessManagedV2`), not just Fleets. Restricted to the Governor role.


```solidity
function revokeOperatorRole(address fleetCommanderAddress, address account) public onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fleetCommanderAddress`|`address`|The contract the Operator role is scoped to (typically a Fleet)|
|`account`|`address`|The account to revoke the role from|


### isWhitelisted

Returns whether `account` is allowed to interact with `context`.


```solidity
function isWhitelisted(address context, address account) public view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context (typically a Fleet address) the check is scoped to|
|`account`|`address`|The account to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|`true` when either `context`'s whitelist is globally open or `account` has an explicit whitelist record for `context`.|


### areWhitelisted

Batch variant of `isWhitelisted`: returns the per-account status array under a single
load of the `_isWhitelistOpen[context]` flag.


```solidity
function areWhitelisted(
    address context,
    address[] calldata accounts
)
    external
    view
    returns (bool[] memory statuses);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the check is scoped to|
|`accounts`|`address[]`|Accounts to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`statuses`|`bool[]`|Array of statuses aligned with `accounts`.|


### isWhitelistOpen

Returns whether `context`'s whitelist has been globally opened.


```solidity
function isWhitelistOpen(address context) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if `context`'s whitelist is globally open.|


### grantWhitelistManagerRole

Grants `WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE` to `account`.

Whitelist managers may call `setWhitelisted`, `setWhitelistedBatch`, and
`setWhitelistOpen`. Restricted to the Governor role.


```solidity
function grantWhitelistManagerRole(address account) external onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The account to grant the role to.|


### revokeWhitelistManagerRole

Revokes `WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE` from `account`.

Restricted to the Governor role.


```solidity
function revokeWhitelistManagerRole(address account) external onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The account to revoke the role from.|


### setWhitelisted

Sets `account`'s explicit whitelist record for `context`.

Idempotent — no event is emitted when the status is unchanged. Restricted to
`WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE`.


```solidity
function setWhitelisted(address context, address account, bool allowed) external onlyRole(WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the record is scoped to|
|`account`|`address`|The account to update|
|`allowed`|`bool`|The new status (`true` for whitelisted, `false` to remove the record).|


### setWhitelistedBatch

Batch variant of `setWhitelisted`. Reverts on length mismatch or when the batch
exceeds `MAX_WHITELIST_BATCH_SIZE`. Restricted to `WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE`.

Note: reverts with `Whitelist_LengthMismatch` if either array is empty.


```solidity
function setWhitelistedBatch(
    address context,
    address[] calldata accounts,
    bool[] calldata allowed
)
    external
    onlyRole(WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the records are scoped to|
|`accounts`|`address[]`|Accounts to update|
|`allowed`|`bool[]`|Per-account statuses, aligned with `accounts`|


### setWhitelistOpen

Sets the global-open flag for `context`. When `true`, every account reads as
whitelisted for `context`. Restricted to `WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE`.


```solidity
function setWhitelistOpen(address context, bool isOpen) external onlyRole(WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context to update|
|`isOpen`|`bool`|The new open status|


### _setWhitelisted

Idempotent setter: only writes and emits `WhitelistStatusUpdated` when the value
actually changes. Used by both single and batch entry points.


```solidity
function _setWhitelisted(address context, address account, bool allowed) internal;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context (e.g. a Fleet address) the status is scoped to|
|`account`|`address`|The account to update|
|`allowed`|`bool`|The new status (`true` to whitelist, `false` to remove)|
